kamaleteruet.headline: Professor & Head of ETE · antennas, biomedical engineering, power electronics
kamaleteruet.bio: Received his PhD from the School of Engineering, Deakin University, Australia, and his BSc in Electronics and Communication Engineering from KUET in 2006. Works on antennas and biomedical engineering: miniature electronic devices for brain stimulation, power electronics and drives, renewable energy, and modelling of biosensors. Member of the Institution of Engineers Bangladesh. Joined RUET in 2007; Head of ETE since August 2021.
education: PhD in Engineering, Deakin University, Australia (2015)

munjuremowlaete.headline: Professor, ETE · 5G/6G wireless, Open RAN, machine learning for communications
munjuremowlaete.bio: Professor of ETE at RUET (currently on leave per the department page). PhD in Wireless Communication Engineering from Edith Cowan University, Australia (2018), MSc in EEE from RUET (2013) and BSc in ECE from KUET (2006). Worked as a telecom engineer for ICX, operator and contractor companies from 2006 to 2010, with Huawei, ZTE, Ericsson and Samsung equipment, and has experience with European H2020 5G/6G projects. IEEE and IEB member; reviewer for IEEE TGCN, TSUSC and IEEE Access.
education: PhD in Communication Engineering, Edith Cowan University, Australia (2018)
researchAreas: IoT, mobile edge and fog computing
